about: The epistola of the formulary “24th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Brethren: We do not cease praying for you and asking that you be filled with the knowledge of the will of God in all wisdom and spiritual understanding, so that you may walk worthily of God, in all things pleasing Him, fruitful in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God, strengthened with all power according to the might of His splendor, in all patience and forbearance with joy, giving thanks to God the Father, who made us worthy of a share in the lot of the saints in the light, who delivered us from the dominion of darkness and carried us over into the kingdom of the Son of His love, in whom we have redemption through His blood, the remission of sins.
